newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei end up, seen supported near-term.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei end up, seen supported near-term.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures ended higher on Friday as players adjusted their positions ahead of a long weekend in Japan.
After hitting a high of 20,750, the benchmark Nikkei 225 December contract ended at 20,630 against a previous settlement at 20,540.
Dealers said there was strong bargain hunting below the 20,500 level and the market's relatively firm close pointed to some stability in the near term.
"I think we've seen the short-term bottom already and we may see it trend a little higher next week on technical factors, if nothing else," said a trader with a U.S. futures house.
"It shouldn't take much to reach 21,000, where it'll pause before heading higher to 21,200/300," he added.
But another trader with a local institution said the market would struggle to get through the 20,750 level and needed to close above 20,950 to see further gains.
"Next week, the possible range will be healthier than this week," he added.
